# Regression cases of the file-header-site-link rule: the header sentence in
# the comment styles the repository uses. A `ruleid` line marks the next line
# as a finding, an `ok` line marks it clean.

# ruleid: file-header-site-link
// Please see https://openpit.dev and the OWNERS file for details.
# ruleid: file-header-site-link
# Please see https://pitofficer.com and the OWNERS file for details.
# ruleid: file-header-site-link
Please see https://officer.openpit.dev/ and the OWNERS file for details.
# ruleid: file-header-site-link
 * Please see http://officer.openpit.dev and the OWNERS file for details.

# ok: file-header-site-link
// Please see https://officer.openpit.dev and the OWNERS file for details.
# ok: file-header-site-link
# Please see https://officer.openpit.dev and the OWNERS file for details.
# ok: file-header-site-link
Please see https://officer.openpit.dev and the OWNERS file for details.
# ok: file-header-site-link
Pit Officer is a control plane for the embeddable OpenPit (https://openpit.dev).
